a11y.notes: Root should render as <header><nav aria-label="Main">...</nav></header> (or a single <nav> landmark). Each nav-item is a link/tab — the currently active one should carry aria-current="page" (see nav-item spec). The user-avatar and language-selector are interactive triggers (likely open a menu/dropdown) and should be real <button> elements with accessible names, not decorative divs, even though this master instance renders them statically.
